description: AgentPad v2 is the ONLY launch target (v1 launches are disabled on-chain; APAD/v1 tokens still trade). Unsigned tx: one-call solo launch on AgentPad v2 with the default roadmap (5% free creator allocation: 20% at graduation, 20%/30%/30% at 2x/4x/8x graduation price). Launch fee 0; initialBuyEth optional. Creator earns 0.50% of every curve trade. REQUIRED (2.4.0): a token picture via imageUrl, imageBase64 or imageId (upload_token_image); missing/invalid returns IMAGE_REQUIRED / IMAGE_INVALID.

imageBase64.description: raw base64 or data:image/...;base64,... of the picture (max 2 MB)

imageUrl.description: REQUIRED unless imageId/imageBase64 is given: https:// (or ipfs://) link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, min 64x64, max 2 MB. We fetch, validate and re-host it.

metadataURI.description: optional: your own https:// or ipfs:// JSON; by default we host metadata with your picture

name: build_launch_tx
